description.prefix: Thread interactions are open by default:

policyEffects.defaultUnset: New cards are open — the board or any agent can respond, including the one that asked.
policyEffects.capUnset: A request keeps whatever audience it asks for.
policyEffects.defaultNotCreator: New cards exclude the agent that created them, so the answer comes from someone else.
policyEffects.defaultHumanOnly: New cards wait for a person on the board. Agents are turned away.
policyEffects.capNotCreator: Even a card that asks for Anyone is narrowed to exclude its creator.
policyEffects.capHumanOnly: Every card of this kind waits for a person, whatever it asked for.

deployment.title: Deployment and auth
deployment.localTrusted: Local trusted mode is optimized for a local operator. Browser requests run as local board context and no sign-in is required.
deployment.authenticatedPublic: Authenticated public mode requires sign-in for board access and is intended for public URLs.
deployment.authenticatedPrivate: Authenticated private mode requires sign-in and is intended for LAN, VPN, or other private-network deployments.

censorUsername.title: Censor username in logs
censorUsername.description: Hide the username segment in home-directory paths and similar operator-visible log output. Standalone username mentions outside of paths are not yet masked in the live transcript view. This is off by default.

keyboardShortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
keyboardShortcuts.description: Enable app keyboard shortcuts, including inbox navigation and global shortcuts like creating tasks or toggling panels. This is off by default.

backupRetention.title: Backup retention
backupRetention.description: Configure how long automatic database backups are retained. Backups run roughly every hour and are compressed with gzip. Within the daily window all backups are kept; beyond that, one backup per week and one per month are preserved.

feedbackSharing.title: AI feedback sharing
feedbackSharing.description: Control whether thumbs up and thumbs down votes can send the voted AI output to Paperclip Labs. Votes are always saved locally.
feedbackSharing.promptNotice: No default is saved yet. The next thumbs up or thumbs down choice will ask once and then save the answer here.
feedbackSharing.dontAllowDescription: Keep voted AI outputs local only.
feedbackSharing.retestRemovePrefix: To retest the first-use prompt in local dev, remove the
feedbackSharing.retestAfterSettingsRow: JSON row for this instance, or set it back to
feedbackSharing.retestSuffix: Unset and "prompt" both mean no default has been chosen yet.

concurrencyPolicyDescriptions.coalesceIfActive: If a run is already active, keep just one follow-up run queued.
concurrencyPolicyDescriptions.alwaysEnqueue: Queue every trigger occurrence, even if the routine is already running.
concurrencyPolicyDescriptions.skipIfActive: Drop new trigger occurrences while a run is still active.

catchUpPolicyDescriptions.skipMissed: Ignore windows that were missed while the scheduler or routine was paused.
catchUpPolicyDescriptions.enqueueMissedWithCap: Catch up missed schedule windows after recovery; sub-hourly schedules are combined into one catch-up run, slower schedules replay each missed window up to a cap.

routines.afterCreation: After creation, Paperclip takes you straight to trigger setup. Draft routines stay paused until you add a default agent.
